preamble: The shift from a labial stop to a postalveolar affricate is a rare but documented form of palatalization, typically occurring when the stop is followed by a high front vowel or a palatal glide.

examples.note: Historical labial + glide cluster palatalized to an affricate
Labial stops undergo palatalization in certain Daco-Romanian varieties
Labial + y clusters coalesced into palatal affricates; the voiced series devoiced with low tone

sources: Tournadre, N., & Dorje, S. (2003). Manual of Standard Tibetan. Snow Lion.
